info.headline: Red Warning: Very Severe Cyclone Approaching Odisha Coast near Cuttack and Puri
info.description: Severe cyclonic storm with sustained wind speeds of 120-140 kmph gusting to 155 kmph expected to make landfall along coastal Odisha. Heavy to very heavy precipitation and tidal surge expected.
info.instruction: Evacuate kutcha houses and coastal areas immediately. Relocate to cyclone shelters. Disconnect power mains before flooding occurs. Do not venture outdoors during calm eye passage.
